"Darlin'" is a song by the American rock band the Beach Boys from their 1967 album Wild Honey.

Written by Brian Wilson and Mike Love, it was inspired by singer Danny Hutton (the title word featured heavily in his vocabulary) and was originally intended to be recorded by an early version of Three Dog Night.
Carl Wilson ultimately sang the lead vocal.
